title: Signal: Package upload endpoint configured over cleartext
scope: A .pypirc file that declares an upload `repository` URL that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches an upload `repository` URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed .pypirc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .pypirc that mentions an upload `repository` URL that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
